title: The Ashline Detective Register
narrativeText: A detective's register only works if every entry is exact. This case is checking work: short pieces of writing with a spelling to catch, and gaps where you choose the word that fits best. If you are the kind of reader who notices the small thing everyone else walked past, this door is yours.
